objective: Bypass goPage and disable Motion on mobile menu entry so the target page is painted before any renderer or scroll/layout work.
owner_authorization: Owner confirmed the published first-paint Motion fix still freezes on a real phone and requested another alternative without further loops.
invariants: No change to business logic, CANON authority, persistence, sync, D1 or R2.
Desktop navigation continues through existing goPage.
Mobile menu entry switches page synchronously without goPage.
Motion is disabled for mobile safe navigation.
Module renderer is scheduled only after the page has had a paint opportunity.
